描述_EN: coat of dark blue silk satin, with scarlet satin borders and sleeve bands; embroidered with coloured silks and gold thread. on the back is the yin-yang symbol, the creative monad, enveloped in rays. the borders are embroidered with flower-baskets, bats, ruyi sceptres and floral stems. the intervals are filled with flying cranes, bats and scrolled clouds. probably worn when attending worship at a daoist temple. on other parts of the garment are the eight trigrams within medallions strewn with fruit, flowers, and daoist symbols. woven with the brand of the treasury manufactory.
描述_ZN: coat of dark blue silk satin, with scarlet satin borders and sleeve bands; embroidered with coloured silks and gold thread. 背面是阴阳符号，即创造性的单体，被光芒所笼罩。 边框绣有花篮、蝙蝠、如意杖和花茎。 间隔处有飞鹤、蝙蝠和卷云。 可能是在参加道教寺庙礼拜时穿的。 衣服的其他部分是八卦图，在散落着水果、鲜花和道教符号的徽章中。 织有国库制造厂的品牌。
